disposition: IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_AUDIT. The two outside-layout directories were migrated into the allowlisted receipts/ owner. Nothing was deleted. manifest.json and SHA256SUMS were deliberately NOT generated — the freeze is a separate, later act.
ruling: Coordinator adjudication 2026-08-05: BOUNDED FORWARD MIGRATION of R1/packets and R1/tools, without deleting material. Options (b) preserved-invalid and (c) contract amendment were not taken.

THE_MEASUREMENT_THAT_SHAPED_THE_MIGRATIO.finding1_checkerIsTopLevelOnly: round-evidence.mjs:67 reads the round root with a NON-RECURSIVE readdirSync and tests each top-level entry name against roundLayout. Anything nested under receipts/ therefore clears the allowlist, which is what made a nested destination available for packets.
THE_MEASUREMENT_THAT_SHAPED_THE_MIGRATIO.finding2_frozenInstrumentCarriesADepthCo: overlay-causality-probe.mjs:92 computes CORE as a fixed five-level walk. Nesting the instruments into receipts/tools/ would have added one level and forced an edit to that file — destroying the FINAL_SHA of an artifact that is FROZEN, writer-retired, and independently corroborated 3/3 by the auditor.
THE_MEASUREMENT_THAT_SHAPED_THE_MIGRATIO.consequence: The destination was chosen by COUPLING, not preference. Instruments moved FLAT into receipts/ because R1/receipts sits at the identical depth to the old R1/tools, preserving all eight five-up constants and the nested fixture's six-up constant. Packets, which have zero executable coupling, moved into receipts/packets/ where the extra level costs nothing and provenance is preserved exactly.

whatMoved.method: mv within one filesystem, which preserves mtime and inode. Nothing copied, nothing deleted, nothing renamed.

STOPPED_DELIBERATELY.handoffNote: The tree is now structurally clean and the only remaining blockers are the two seal artifacts. Whoever opens the freeze window should re-verify the 16 migrated hashes and the frozen instrument's four bindings first.
